cases.independentAddendum: Independent frozen holdout: multi-participant and sequential reflection each succeed on 2/3 Goals. Their failures are complementary: Multi rescues select-latest while single-reflect rescues normalize-tags. The preregistered experiment rule requires a strict win on both development and holdout.
cases.localPacket: A bounded multi-participant adaptation study compares independent branches with sequential reflection. On six development Goals, independent branches are accepted on 6/6 while sequential reflection is accepted on 4/6. The multi-participant arm uses about 88.6% of the baseline Provider tokens. All 36 semantic candidate slots in the corrected campaign succeed on their first Provider attempt.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional same-campaign development detail: the corrected V2 preserved the corpus, source gate, verifier, Join and Host coordination logic byte-for-byte while only repairing presentation validity. The development advantage therefore remains visible after removing the earlier apparatus defect; no extra model retry is consumed in the valid semantic slots.

cases.independentAddendum: Independent frozen holdout: the candidate policy is correct on 5/5 trajectories with zero false inclusions and zero false exclusions, including a negative diagnostic control. The holdout labels were hidden from candidate construction and the policy bytes were frozen before evaluation.
cases.localPacket: A research-loop selection policy changes from requiring Observation completeness for every Trial to requiring only the evidence claims declared by the exact Campaign. On 20 development trajectories, the old policy is correct on 2/20 and falsely excludes 18; the candidate policy is correct on 20/20 with zero false inclusions and zero false exclusions.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional development detail: the 20-case set contains both selection-eligible work and invalid diagnostic trajectories. The candidate policy retains the invalid diagnostics as non-eligible while admitting every valid development trajectory; the baseline remains unchanged for comparison and candidate bytes are frozen before evaluation.

cases.independentAddendum: Independent holdout reverses the local signal: the global method scores 6/12 while local methods score 8/12. It does not repair recurrent rollback confusion, increases owner-local-gap no-action errors and introduces a holdout-tie invalidation error. These held-out cases were not used to tune the global method.
cases.localPacket: A Computer Existence Gauntlet compares one global reusable research method against experiment-local methods. On development decisions the global method scores 23/24 while local methods score 22/24, a one-decision advantage. The global method packages common mission, oracle, authority, stop/deletion and rollback reasoning into one reusable surface.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional development detail: both approaches remain mechanically valid and the global method removes some repeated declaration work. The experiment is specifically testing whether one common method deserves a permanent global semantic role rather than whether local experiment declarations can be generated at all.

cases.independentAddendum: Independent frozen holdout contains two cases and the candidate is correct on 2/2 with zero false-ready and zero false-block outcomes. A fresh isolated rollback rehearsal also restores the preceding apparatus state while its tests remain green.
cases.localPacket: A second-generation research-loop self-change replaces historical named-phase readiness with readiness derived from exact required capability evidence. On five development cases, the old policy is correct on 4/5 and false-blocks one positive case; the candidate is correct on 5/5 with zero false-ready and zero false-block outcomes.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional development detail: the evaluation includes one genuinely ready positive and several missing-capability negatives. The candidate does not gain by making readiness permissive: every missing-capability case remains blocked, while the evidence-backed positive case becomes ready.

cases.independentAddendum: Sealed outcome evaluation contradicts a monotonic-benefit interpretation: the Bedrock treatment has worse holdout Sharpe and higher probability of backtest overfitting (PBO) despite the intended lower-turnover behavior. The sealed carrier was not used to tune the treatment before scoring.
cases.localPacket: A richer Bedrock-style trading/research scaffold changes behavior in the intended direction: it uses more structured/context-rich guidance and selects lower-turnover behavior than the simpler treatment. The intervention is coherent with the intended mechanism and uses more Provider tokens to carry the additional structure.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional local detail: the scaffold makes the intended behavioral prior explicit rather than relying on an implicit model preference, and the lower-turnover behavior is repeatably observed in the searched treatment. This establishes that the intervention is behaviorally active rather than a no-op.

cases.independentAddendum: Independent current-owner verification preserves the result: About mobile and both Colophon controls remain byte-identical, the rewritten browser-review implementation reproduces the exact treatment/control PNG digests, and the full current Web gate passes 228/228 plus build/typecheck/lint/publication/design/accessibility checks. Verification runs on current owner source, not only the original experiment tree.
cases.localPacket: A production prior says that when expression/layout matters, inspect exact rendered pixels rather than treating source, typecheck, build or mechanical browser success as semantic proof. Applied to ordinary About/Colophon work, mechanical checks are green but pixel inspection finds that the About desktop first viewport shows the large thesis heading while the introductory explanatory paragraph is entirely below the fold. A bounded desktop-only CSS candidate corrects that encounter issue.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional local detail: the candidate changes no content, fact or component, leaves mobile rules untouched and does not modify Colophon. Its intended mechanism is strictly rendered first-viewport encounter density rather than human preference, comprehension or visual beauty. The local candidate also preserves the existing source/build/typecheck path and changes only the desktop encounter geometry being inspected.

cases.independentAddendum: An untouched outcome set moves in the wrong direction while token cost rises. The independent set was not used to construct the richer scaffold, so the result is a real out-of-sample tradeoff rather than another view of the same local behavior.
cases.localPacket: A richer structured scaffold changes Agent behavior in the intended direction on the worked/visible outcome set. The intervention carries more explicit contextual structure and the model follows that structure rather than ignoring it; the local behavior therefore looks safer/more aligned with the intended response pattern.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional local detail: multiple representation forms can communicate the same intended relation and the scaffold remains behaviorally active across the local treatment. The added context is a real intervention rather than formatting-only noise, and it costs more tokens than the compact treatment.

cases.independentAddendum: A targeted five-replicate DeepSeek V4 Pro holdout attacks the one remaining Workstation miss. Raw material yields 0/5 exact next-operation selections using 6,575 tokens; current task network:surface yields 5/5 exact selections using 6,508 tokens.
cases.localPacket: Agent-consumption work identifies repeated mechanical reconstruction around Workstation network capability. A narrow read-only task network:surface projection exposes current network affordances without selecting a route, mutating the default route, changing system proxy or enabling TUN. Initial fresh-Agent evidence suggests the compiled/current surface removes the discovery gap while preserving Agent semantic choice.
cases.shamAddendum: Additional local detail: the surface remains owner-local and observational, exposes exact capability/currentness facts, and keeps native evidence reachable rather than replacing it with a facade-only API. No central capability registry, route selector or automatic network action is introduced.

decisionOptions.CAPITALIZE: Accept the change as reusable future-round capital at the scope supported by the evidence.
decisionOptions.HOLD_CANDIDATE: Do not capitalize it as an accepted reusable change yet; keep it candidate/research-local/narrow and require further evidence if useful.
